svg.title: Forge icon refined vector
svg.desc:
The viewBox is cropped to the artwork, and only the viewBox: not one path coordinate has been touched. It was 0 0 800 800 around a drawing living in x 137 to 690, y 157 to 642, which is 42% of the area with the rest empty, so however large the slot on the page the anvil read as small and lost in it. Cropped, the same slot shows the drawing about half again as large, and the mark is landscape as it actually is rather than square with padding.
Written as a desc rather than a comment on purpose: an XML comment may not contain a double hyphen, and one in an earlier draft of this note made the file invalid. An SVG loaded through an img tag must be well formed, so the browser dropped it silently and reported naturalWidth 0.
Vectorized SVG of a Minecraft-like forge icon with anvil, hammer, ingot, and sparks.
